rule: Core means search priority, not automatic inclusion. Mechanisms are editorial hypotheses, not claims that any event occurred. Every candidate needs a new observed trigger, evidence and an event-specific path. Do not count a mechanism twice across overlapping themes.

themes.trigger_conditions: New payment/covenant failure, distressed exchange, restructuring or economically meaningful amendment.
themes.transmission_mechanism: Cash-flow shortfall → debt-service stress → revised recovery/loss assumptions → portfolio marks and returns.
themes.inclusion_threshold: Specific borrower/fund exposure or credible evidence of a relevant market trend; distinguish allegations and formal status.
themes.common_false_positives: Routine refinancing; contractual PIK; amendments without evidence of changed economics.

themes.trigger_conditions: New OTF results or comparable peer data with meaningful NAV, non-accrual, leverage, PIK or coverage change.
themes.transmission_mechanism: Borrower deterioration → non-accrual/valuation changes → BDC earnings, loss risk and distributable income.
themes.inclusion_threshold: Same period and cost/fair-value basis; direct vehicle result or informative peer trend. Do not infer all private credit from one BDC.
themes.common_false_positives: NAV ex-dividend changes treated as impairment; NII mistaken for cash; mixing cost/fair-value percentages.

themes.trigger_conditions: Verified deterioration in software cash flow, retention, covenants or financing conditions.
themes.transmission_mechanism: Weaker recurring revenue/cash generation → weaker coverage → amendments/recovery risk → lender marks and sponsor value.
themes.inclusion_threshold: Identified borrower debt connection or credible sector evidence; no requirement that a watched GP is named.
themes.common_false_positives: Stock-price falls alone; generic tech layoffs; equating ARR with debt-service capacity.

themes.trigger_conditions: Material new issuance/terms, reset/refinancing change or comparable spread/volume movement.
themes.transmission_mechanism: Collateral yield minus liability funding and costs → issuance/reinvestment economics → tranche/equity cash flows.
themes.inclusion_threshold: State tranche, currency, asset versus liability spread, period and comparison; manager-specific materiality or market read-through.
themes.common_false_positives: Tiny daily move, syndicated duplication, conflating asset spreads and liability spreads.

themes.trigger_conditions: New decision, meaningful guidance change or substantiated repricing with relevant exposure sensitivity.
themes.transmission_mechanism: Higher floating base rates → higher borrower interest expense → weaker coverage/default risk; lender income may rise initially. Discount rates/refinancing also affect property and exit values.
themes.inclusion_threshold: Observed new trigger plus named strategy sensitivity, horizon and at least one consequential channel; weigh floors/hedges if known.
themes.common_false_positives: Routine speech, calendar reminder, unsupported predicted policy change or generic macro importance.

themes.trigger_conditions: New lending-standard data or scoped rule affecting bank credit capacity/warehouse supply.
themes.transmission_mechanism: Reduced bank capacity → non-bank opportunity but potentially tighter warehouse/fund financing → changed deployment, leverage and returns.
themes.inclusion_threshold: Specify affected lender/borrower segment, jurisdiction, proposal/final status and relevant channel.
themes.common_false_positives: Generic bank earnings, retail branch change or treating all tightening as positive for private credit.

themes.trigger_conditions: New adopted/proposed capital treatment or insurer capital constraint affecting relevant assets.
themes.transmission_mechanism: Changed capital charges/eligibility → insurer demand and funding capacity → asset pricing, origination and manager capital formation.
themes.inclusion_threshold: Identify rule, jurisdiction, affected instrument and status; Apollo/Athene or other manager link only if evidenced.
themes.common_false_positives: Annuity marketing; unrelated insurance claims; assuming proposed rule is effective law.

themes.trigger_conditions: Company/sector evidence of AI affecting retention, pricing, margins or financing.
themes.transmission_mechanism: AI substitution or efficiency gains → changed recurring revenue/cash flow → borrower debt capacity and enterprise value → lender/sponsor outcomes.
themes.inclusion_threshold: Observed evidence beyond an AI narrative; distinguish hypothesis from demonstrated borrower impact.
themes.common_false_positives: New model launch, broad job-loss predictions, assumption that all software credit deteriorates.

themes.trigger_conditions: Material debt/lease/project financing or stress with identified counterparties and terms.
themes.transmission_mechanism: Construction/power/tenant concentration → cash-flow and collateral risk → funding terms, deployment and valuation.
themes.inclusion_threshold: Identified financing instrument, capital provider role and risk/return consequence; nameplate project value is not debt deployed.
themes.common_false_positives: Chip sales or AI partnership without financing evidence; all infrastructure tagged private credit.

themes.trigger_conditions: New gate, unusual redemption restriction, extension, LP sale or GP-led continuation transaction.
themes.transmission_mechanism: Liquidity mismatch/slow distributions → redemption pressure or secondary discounts → funding, NAV and exit conditions.
themes.inclusion_threshold: Identify vehicle, rule/change and source; distinguish ordinary scheduled caps, manager equity and LP/fund asset transactions.
themes.common_false_positives: Routine disclosed redemption window; secondary stock trading; GP-led secondary labelled GP stakes.

themes.trigger_conditions: Material financing terms/availability or evidenced change in sale/IPO/exit conditions.
themes.transmission_mechanism: Debt cost and leverage capacity → acquisition pricing and refinancing feasibility → sponsor realizations/distributions and lender deployment.
themes.inclusion_threshold: Specific relevant financing change or strong comparative exit data; routine bolt-on without transmission fails.
themes.common_false_positives: Deal count with no scope/baseline; equity M&A automatically treated as credit; speculative IPO timetable.
